4161.title: Synchronous cleanup of wide event rows
4161.rootCauseOneLine: Cleanup executes synchronous wide-row updates before yielding; its byte budget permits one oversized event, but multi-second latency was not reproduced.
4161.proposedFix: Measure file-backed cold-cache and contention behavior before choosing a fix; time checks cannot interrupt a synchronous statement.
4161.caveats: Only the blocking mechanism was reproduced; synthetic in-memory calls took 0.322–6.282 ms. SQLite avoids full payload reads for octet_length in the tested build.
